sources: Google Maps panel 'Lake LaMoure' (4.6, 19 reviews; the lake, no phone), read 2026-11-12
summary: City of LaMoure recreation page confirms a public boat ramp and a campground with electric hookups, contact 883-4259 (stored phone right); it gives no rate, site count, amperage, sewer, booking or season. Lakeview kept (camper report of a lake view through trees; trailers 15-40 m from shore on imagery, sites unnumbered). Nothing written.
flags: WATERFRONT (lakeview kept): the camping cluster at the stored pin (46.3010,-98.2835) has ~4-5 RVs on open sandy/grass ground 15-40 m from the shore with private-looking docks and boats beside them, which could be seasonal units; no site map or numbers exist, so on-water cannot be earned. The only site-level account (The Dyrt, 2024-05-11, reported): 'Beautiful view of the lake though and protected by the trees'; 'Site5'. Lakeview stands; an upgrade would need numbered nightly sites on open ground.

UNREAD/UNPUBLISHED: the city page says only 'Public boat ramp and camp ground with electric hook-ups. For more information contact ... 883-4259.' No rate (The Dyrt shows $15-20, directory), no amperage, no site count. The derived sewer:true and reservable:true rest on earlier sweep prose (ndtourism.com, which refuses plain HTTP; not fetched); left as stored. A 2024 camper review (reported) mentions 'hookups water and sewer', 'Pit toilets no showers' and a dump station 'around the corner'.

OPERATOR: the note's 'Lake LaMoure Association together with ND Game & Fish' was not confirmed on any page read; the city page lists it among LaMoure recreation with a local contact. PHONE: 701-883-4259 confirmed on the city page (a named local contact). WEBSITE: https://www.lamourend.com/recreation/ is the operator-side page (keep).
